description.en-US: *Spare, O Lord, spare Thy people* — the Lenten plea of the prophet Joel, with verses that call the faithful to weep before the Judge.
description.pt-BR: *Perdoai, Senhor, perdoai ao vosso povo* — a súplica quaresmal do profeta Joel, com estrofes que chamam os fiéis a chorar diante do Juiz.

history.en-US: The antiphon is Joel 2:17, the cry of the priests between the porch and the altar; its verses are taken from the Lenten hymns of the Breviary, *Ex more docti mystico* and *Audi, benigne Conditor*.
history.pt-BR: A antífona é Joel 2, 17, o clamor dos sacerdotes entre o vestíbulo e o altar; as estrofes vêm dos hinos quaresmais do Breviário, *Ex more docti mystico* e *Audi, benigne Conditor*.

source.en-US: Latin: *The Liber Usualis* (Desclée, 1961), p. 1868, as transcribed in [GregoBase](https://gregobase.selapa.net/chant.php?id=3038) · English: *The Parish Book of Chant* (Church Music Association of America, 2nd ed., 2012), p. 142 — [musicasacra.com](https://media.musicasacra.com/pdf/pbc-web.pdf)
source.pt-BR: Latim: *The Liber Usualis* (Desclée, 1961), p. 1868, conforme a transcrição do [GregoBase](https://gregobase.selapa.net/chant.php?id=3038) · Inglês: *The Parish Book of Chant* (Church Music Association of America, 2.ª ed., 2012), p. 142 — [musicasacra.com](https://media.musicasacra.com/pdf/pbc-web.pdf) · O português foi traduzido do latim para este aplicativo.
